claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-015
Date of Incident: September 3, 2021
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide at 0:13 states 'FRIDAY SEPTEMBER 03, 2021 AT 14:08 HOURS', confirming the date of the incident.

claims.claim_text: Time of Incident: Approximately 1350–1408 hours
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide states the incident occurred at 14:08 hours, while the claim specifies a time range of 1350–1408 hours. The video transcript shows the officer requesting medical assistance at 1408 hours, indicating the incident concluded within that timeframe, making the upper limit of 1408 hours plausible but the lower limit of 1350 hours unsupported by the clip.

claims.claim_text: Location: Orangethorpe Avenue to Buena Park Unified School District parking lot, Buena Park, CA
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide specifies the location as '6885 ORANGETHORPE AVENUE, BUENA PARK', while the claim describes a location 'Orangethorpe Avenue to Buena Park Unified School District parking lot'. The video shows the subject entering a parking lot, but the specific 'Buena Park Unified School District parking lot' is not explicitly confirmed in the visible text or audio within this clip.

claims.claim_text: Reporting Officer: Detective M. Castellano
Badge Number: 5839
Subject: Raymond Givens, Male, 61 years old, Black
Officer(s): Detective M. Castellano, Officer K. Nakamura, Officer E. Fuentes
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows multiple officers, including one who appears to be Detective M. Castellano and another who may be Officer K. Nakamura, but it is not possible to visually confirm the identity of Officer E. Fuentes.

claims.claim_text: Victim(s): Linda Torres (W-1), school bus driver; one 6-year-old child passenger
On September 3, 2021, I was working a special assignment as a detective with the Community Impact Team.
At approximately 1359 hours, I monitored a radio broadcast that an armed individual had discharged a firearm at a school bus on Orangethorpe Avenue.
I was on the far north side of the city at the time of the broadcast.
I activated my emergency lights and responded to the area.
Upon arrival in the area, I observed a grey Chevrolet Suburban being pursued southbound by Officer Fuentes, who had his marked unit's emergency lights and sirens activated.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a grey Chevrolet Suburban being pursued, but it does not confirm that Officer Fuentes was pursuing it with marked unit emergency lights and sirens activated, nor does it confirm the subject was being pursued southbound.

claims.claim_text: I joined the pursuit and, due to damage to Officer Fuentes's vehicle from a prior attempted vehicle stop, I assumed the lead position.
At the time I became lead vehicle, the subject had been pursued with continuously activated lights and sirens for over seven minutes.
At approximately 1407 hours, the subject turned into the Buena Park Unified School District Office parking lot, driving through the closed entry gate and dislodging it from its hinges.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the vehicle entering a parking lot through a gate, but the claim states the subject 'dislodging it from its hinges.' The video does not clearly show the gate being dislodged from its hinges, only that the vehicle drives through a gate.

claims.claim_text: I followed the subject into the parking lot.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer following the subject into the parking lot after the vehicle turns in.

claims.claim_text: I was aware from radio traffic that the subject had fired at a school bus carrying children and that the subject was armed with a handgun.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer following a vehicle into a parking lot, which aligns with the claim that he joined the pursuit and entered the parking lot.

claims.claim_text: An Anaheim PD helicopter overhead confirmed the subject's location in the parking lot.
Once in the parking lot, the subject's vehicle collided with a parked vehicle at low speed before coming to a complete stop.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the vehicle colliding with a parked vehicle and coming to a stop, consistent with the claim of a low-speed collision before stopping.

claims.claim_text: I exited my vehicle and took a position of cover behind the engine block.
claims.evidence_observations: The officer exits the vehicle and takes cover behind the engine block, which is visible in the footage.

claims.claim_text: The subject remained seated inside the vehicle for approximately thirty seconds before exiting.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer exiting his vehicle and taking a position behind the engine block of his car, which aligns with the claim of taking a position of cover.

claims.claim_text: When the subject exited the vehicle, I observed him holding a handgun in his left hand.
claims.evidence_observations: The video does not show the subject holding a handgun in his left hand when exiting the vehicle.

claims.claim_text: The subject turned toward me and raised the weapon in my direction.
claims.evidence_observations: The video does not show the subject turning toward the officer and raising the weapon in their direction.

claims.claim_text: I discharged my firearm thirteen times at the subject.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer firing his weapon, but it is not possible to determine from the visual evidence alone whether he discharged his firearm thirteen times.

claims.claim_text: Almost immediately, Officer Nakamura arrived on scene in a marked patrol vehicle wearing a full police uniform with badge and shoulder patches.
Officer Nakamura also discharged his firearm at the subject.
The subject walked toward us for several seconds while pointing his weapon before falling to the ground.
The total duration of gunfire was no more than approximately ten seconds.
Officer Nakamura and I ceased fire once the subject fell to the ground and was no longer pointing the weapon.
I immediately requested medical assistance via radio at 1408 hours.
Due to the subject still holding the firearm, we formulated a plan to safely approach, which we executed at approximately 1413 hours.
We handcuffed the subject, removed the weapon, and began rendering first aid.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows multiple officers handcuffing the subject, removing the weapon, and beginning to render first aid, which aligns with the claim that they handcuffed the subject, removed the weapon, and began rendering first aid.

claims.claim_text: Orange County Fire Authority paramedics arrived at 1420 hours and took over medical treatment.
The subject was pronounced deceased on scene at approximately 1445 hours.
The child passenger had already been removed from the bus prior to the shooting at the school district parking lot.
W-1 had dropped the child at a school earlier on her route, and the bus was empty at the time the subject fired his weapon at it on Orangethorpe Avenue.
Body-worn camera footage (Detective Castellano, Officer Nakamura)
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows body-worn camera footage from Detective Castellano and Officer Nakamura, as indicated by the context of the clip.
